title: [review] stack.rs: Security-critical epoch validation only enforced i
description: The check `epoch >= 128` uses `debug_assert!`, which is compiled out in release builds. Per spec section 4.4, epoch values below 128 violate replay protection requirements. This security invariant should use a runtime check that returns an error or panics in all builds, not just debug.
close_reason: Fixed: Changed debug_assert! to assert! for epoch validation so the security check runs in release builds
